# Language accuracy comparison (FLEURS)

## Spanish

| Engine | WER | 95% CI |
|---|---:|---|
| Parakeet Ultra, FluidAudio (Core ML) | 2.8% | 2.4% – 3.3% |
| Parakeet Ultra, sherpa-onnx (ONNX, community export) | 3.2% | 2.7% – 3.7% |
| Apple SpeechAnalyzer, es-ES | 4.0% | 3.4% – 4.5% |

## French

| Engine | WER | 95% CI |
|---|---:|---|
| Parakeet Ultra, FluidAudio (Core ML) | 4.5% | 3.9% – 5.1% |
| Parakeet Ultra, sherpa-onnx (ONNX, community export) | 6.2% | 5.5% – 6.9% |
| Apple SpeechAnalyzer, fr-FR | 7.5% | 6.7% – 8.3% |
